description: NaN(CN)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to six N atoms to form edge-sharing NaN₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.57 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to two N atoms. There is one shorter (1.19 Å) and one longer (1.30 Å) C-N bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to two N atoms. There is one shorter (1.18 Å) and one longer (1.30 Å) C-N bond length. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the third N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two C atoms.
